notes.content:
Hello!

Thank you all for the support on Loving You Fully. I have published an update that fixes the typos that I was able to find within the game. :)

notes.title: Fall in love with hot vampires in my new game!
notes.content:
Hey guys, hope you are all doing well!

Wanted to inform you that my newest game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1877580/Panicked_and_Surrounded_by_Hot_Vampires/]Panicked and Surrounded by Hot Vampires is now available on Steam[/url]. Just like Loving You Fully, the game is free so don't worry about having to spend any money. Save all that hard-earned cash for the next Steam sale!

Panicked and Surrounded by Hot Vampires was made in about 2-ish months. You play as Chester H. Smith, a relatively plain 47-year-old man. He is sent to survey a castle out in the woods. When he arrives, it turns out the castle is owned by vampires. Will Chester fall in love with either one, both, or will he be alone? Or perhaps even die? That's up to you!

Panicked and Surrounded by Hot Vampires is a comedy, romance game that talks about life and death featuring eternal characters and a character who is running out of time. If that sounds like something up your alley, I hope you take the time to play the game. :)

notes.title: Loving You Fully: Small Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you all for the wonderful amount of support for Loving You Fully! I wasn't entirely sure how this type of game would go over on the platform, so I'm happy to know that players enjoy it. For people looking to get into Loving You Fully, I just put out a small patch to remedy an issue that was brought to my attention.

The size of the font has been made smaller. The Open Dyslexic font was too big and would often go off the screen or be cut off. Due to my little programming knowledge, I had to change the size for both the default and Open Dyslexic font to fix this issue!
